v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Ámplius lava me, * Dómine, ab iniustítia mea.
text.en: O Lord, wash me * yet more from my iniquity.
O Lord, * thou wilt pardon our transgressions.

text.la: In innocéntia * cordis mei perambulábo, Dómine.
text.en: I walked in the innocence * of my heart, O Lord.

text.la: Exsultávit cor meum * in Dómino, qui humíliat et súblevat.
text.en: My heart hath rejoiced * in the Lord, he humbleth and he exalteth.

text.la: Lauda * ánima mea Dóminum, qui érigit elísos et díligit iustos.
text.en: Praise * the Lord my soul, he lifts up those who fall, and loves the just.

text.la: Clama, ne cesses, quasi tuba exálta vocem tuam, et annúntia pópulo meo scélera eórum, et dómui Iacob peccáta eórum.
text.en: Cry, cease not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and show my people their wicked doings, and the house of Jacob their sins.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Generátio * hæc prava et pervérsa signum quærit: et signum non dábitur ei, nisi signum Ionæ prophétæ.
text.en: This evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; * and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the Prophet Jonas.

text.la: Preces nostras, quǽsumus, Dómine, cleménter exáudi: et contra cuncta nobis adversántia déxteram tuæ maiestátis exténde.
text.en: O Lord, we beseech thee mercifully to hear our prayers, and to stretch forth the right hand of thy power against all things that fight against us.

text.la: Euge, serve bone et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, intra in gáudium Dómini tui.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things; enter thou into the joy of thy Lord.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Deus, qui beátum Ioánnem, tuo amóre succénsum, inter flammas innóxium incédere fecísti, et per eum Ecclésiam tuam nova prole fecundásti: præsta, ipsíus suffragántibus méritis; ut igne caritátis tuæ vítia nostra curéntur, et remédia nobis ætérna provéniant.
text.en: O God, Who didst so enkindle in thy servant John the fire of thy Divine love, that when he walked in the midst of earthly fire the flame thereof had on his body no power, and Who didst choose him for a means whereby Thou hast given unto thy Church a new family of sons, mercifully grant unto us, for his sake, that the fire of thy love may burn up in us all things that displease thee, and make us meet for thy heavenly kingdom.
